title: Manuscript
description: The text of a narrative in manuscript format v1: every scene in narrative order, each with its beat and its blocks in reading order. A renderer turns it into a consumer format, such as a novel, a screenplay or a game.

formatVersion.description: The version of the format the document follows.

language.description: The language of the text, as a BCP 47 tag such as en or fr. The renderer applies its typography.

scenes.description: Every scene of the narrative, in narrative order: by beat, then by position in the beat. A scene without text keeps its place with no blocks.

appendices.description: Data about the text, keyed by appendix name. A reader skips an appendix it does not know.

beats.description: Every beat of the narrative, in narrative order, those without scenes included. A scene names its beat by its position here, from 0.

scene.description: One scene of the narrative. A block of the scene is named by its position, from 0.

beat.description: The position of the scene's beat in the beats appendix.
One beat of the narrative: a turn of the story's structure, which its scenes tell.

description.description: What the beat is for, written for the author. Empty when the author wrote none.
